verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a single pricing-page line saying Zoho Invoice integrates with Zoho Books, a general-ledger accounting product. That counts as a thin first-party GL integration, but nothing documents what syncs (invoices, payments, recognition entries) or whether QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite are supported. The general-purpose REST API is only a developer building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented sync of invoices and payments to the GL, revenue-recognition entry sync, QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite connectors, sync depth/frequency details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, invoices, payments, and recognition entries sync to my general ledger or ERP — QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite — so the close doesn't need CSV surgery

citations.quote: Integrate with Zoho CRM, Analytics, Books, and more.
